title: Waste-derived carbon nanomaterials for electrochemical applications: toward a circular and sustainable future
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,733-747
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08357E, Review Article
Open Access

Shruthi Venkataraman, Ashok K. Sundramoorthy
This review underscored the profound potential of upcycling diverse waste streams ranging from plastic and electronic waste to agricultural biomass into high-value CNTs, graphene, and CQDs and their use in electrochemical sensors.
